κνυζ-ηθμός , ὁ, prop. of dogs,
A.whining, whimpering, opp. barking or snarling, “κύνες τε ἴδον καί ῥ᾽ οὐχ ὑλάοντο, κνυζηθμῷ δ᾽ ἑτέρωσε διὰ σταθμοῖο φόβηθεν”
Od. 16.163
; of wild beasts, A.R. 3.884 ; of young bears, Opp. C. 3.169 (pl.); of children, Ath. 9.376a .
From A Greek-English Lexicon (Henry George Liddell, Robert Scott, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1940)
